visual.description: Mortality risk curve on dark bg. X-axis: sleep hours (4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9). Y-axis: relative mortality risk. The <6h zone is shaded in negative red (#E06070) with '+10%' label. The 6–7h zone in muted warning with '+4%'. The 7–9h zone is baseline green (#5BBF8C). Clean, minimal chart. Source: RAND RR-1791.

notes: Key visual — this mortality curve gets referenced later. Uses RAND's <6h threshold, not CDC's <7h.
